headline: Safran Meets Q3 Revenue Estimates as Unchanged 2026 Goals Lag Consensus
summary: Safran delivered third-quarter revenue in line with forecasts but maintained 2026 financial targets that sit below market consensus estimates.
why: Safran is a top supplier of aircraft engines, avionics, and landing gear to commercial airframers such as Airbus and Boeing.

impacts.name: Safran SA
impacts.why: Retaining multi-year targets below analyst consensus dampens future earnings projections.
